statement: For every proper genus n at least2, choose an odd prime p congruent3 modulo4 not dividing n, a point Q of order p on E:y^2=x^3-x, and f with divisor p(O-Q). The normalization C:z^n=f, with the full inverse image of E[p^a] removed, gives an actual degree n*p^(2a) cover of U, genus n, and 2+n*(p^(2a)-2) cusps. At every coefficient prime and every selected cusp packet, the full derived fixed subgroup is selected cusp inertia; every nontrivial procyclic subgroup with open arithmetic normalizer is cuspidal.
depends_on: A.41 and A.42 (all-prime compact-type rational-path fixed criterion)
Silverman Theorem V.4.1(a), p.148, and Example V.4.5, p.152 (supersingular reduction)
answers: Part A Task5: complete explicit cover families in every proper genus, including even genera
notes: Full independent root proof/source audit PASS and certificate rerun PASS. Registered after checkpoint07 release. The actual normalization map to the original good elliptic model forces every extra cusp onto the rational core or an attaching node; separating all marks adds only rational trees and chains. Each positive-genus component maps isomorphically to the original elliptic component, so the tame component-support obstruction applies to the actual punctured map. No CM assumption on the higher-genus Jacobian and no cofinality claim are used. Code/a_all_genus_kummer.py and exact outputs retain the genus-four example of degree36 and30 cusps.
